title: Form controls drawn as machines
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: 96 checkboxes as the tappets of a 24-hour timer, radios that set the speed of a turning record, a number input on a drum behind a darkroom safelight, buttons lit by a pendant lamp that swings to the one in use, and a text field with a Morse key that types.
question: Can a hit region be placed with a rotated draw (96 checkboxes round a dial), and can a held button, a turned range and a typed-in field each drive a drawn machine?
result: Yes in the test browser. A draw with no alpha under ctx.rotate() put each checkbox's hit region on its tappet. The Morse key and the knob keep their own pointer state. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
